verses.text: For the lead musician. A psalm by David. LORD, you’ve searched me all the way through, and you know me.
You know when I sit down and when I get up. You understand my thoughts from far away.
You know the road I take and where I lie down. Every way I live is familiar to you.
Before I even get a word out, LORD, you already know the whole thing.
You surround me front and back and put your hand on me.
Knowing that blows my mind. It’s too high for me to reach.
Where could I go to get away from your Spirit? Where could I run from your presence?
If I go up to heaven, you’re there. If I make my bed in Sheol, there you are too!
If I ride out on the wings of the dawn and settle at the farthest edge of the sea,
even there your hand will lead me and your right hand will hold me.
If I say, “Surely the darkness will swallow me, and the light around me will turn to night,”
even darkness can’t hide from you. Night shines like day, because darkness is like light to you.
You formed the deepest parts of me. You knitted me together in my mother’s womb.
I thank you because you made me in a way that fills me with awe. What you do is wonderful, and I know that deep down.
My frame wasn’t hidden from you when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.
You saw my body. All the days set for me were written in your book before even one of them had come.
How precious your thoughts are to me, God! There are so many of them!
If I tried counting them, there’d be more than grains of sand. When I wake up, I’m still with you.
If only you’d put the wicked to death, God. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty people!
They speak against you with evil intent. Your enemies misuse your name.
LORD, don’t I hate those who hate you? Don’t I grieve over those who rise against you?
I hate them completely. They’ve become my enemies.
Search me, God, and know what’s in my heart. Test me and know my thoughts.
See if there’s any wicked path in me, and lead me down the way that lasts forever.
